mapper.select: SELECT * FROM approval_records WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM approval_records WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_records (submission_id, approval_level, approver_id, status, comment) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{approvalLevel}, #{approverId}, #{status}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT ar.id AS approval_id, s.id AS submission_id, ar.approval_level, a.title AS assignment_title, a.period_label, t.name AS template_name, c.name AS company_name, u.display_name AS submitted_by_name, COALESCE(s.submitted_at, s.created_at) AS submitted_at, s.version, s.comment FROM approval_records ar JOIN report_submissions s ON s.id = ar.submission_id JOIN report_assignments a ON a.id = s.assignment_id JOIN report_templates t ON t.id = a.template_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = s.submitted_by_company_id JOIN users u ON u.id = s.submitted_by WHERE ar.status = 'pending' AND s.submitted_by_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( (#{role} = 'reviewer' AND ar.approval_level = 'reviewer') OR (#{role} = 'approver' AND ar.approval_level = 'approver') ) ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC

SELECT 'submission_rejected' AS kind, a.id AS assignment_id, a.title, a.period_label, a.deadline, ar.approval_level AS stage, ar.comment, u.display_name AS rejected_by_name, ar.updated_at AS rejected_at FROM report_assignments a JOIN report_submissions s ON s.assignment_id = a.id AND s.status = 'rejected' JOIN approval_records ar ON ar.submission_id = s.id AND ar.status = 'rejected' LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = ar.approver_id WHERE a.assigned_to_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.status = 'rejected' ORDER BY ar.updated_at DESC

SELECT 'receipt_returned' AS kind, a.id AS assignment_id, a.title, a.period_label, a.deadline, NULL AS stage, r.comment, u.display_name AS rejected_by_name, r.created_at AS rejected_at FROM report_assignments a JOIN report_submissions s ON s.assignment_id = a.id AND s.status = 'returned' JOIN submission_receipts r ON r.submission_id = s.id AND r.action = 'returned' LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.received_by WHERE a.assigned_to_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.status = 'returned' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM users WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND role = 'reviewer' AND status = 'active' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM users WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND role = 'approver' AND status = 'active' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
